Článek
Ruská protivzdušná obrana v noci na čtvrtek nad mnoha částmi Ruska zničila 1214 ukrajinských bezpilotních letounů, uvedlo podle agentury TASS ministerstvo obrany v Moskvě. Je to patrně rekordní počet. Na řadě letišť byl omezen provoz. O velkých škodách v důsledku ukrajinských útoků se ale TASS nezmiňuje.
Noční útok na Moskvu byl podle agentury jedním z nejrozsáhlejších od začátku letošního roku. Starosta metropole Sergej Sobjanin na platformě Max napsal, že od středy 20:30 do dnešních 07:00 mířilo k moskevskému regionu 613 dronů. Většinu z nich se podle něj podařilo zničit ve větší vzdálenosti od hlavního města, dalších 231 při přiblížení k Moskvě.
Fico u Babiše. Vřelost musí mít limity, když slovenská vláda jezdí do Moskvy

shrnuti: Ukraine's Air Force says Russia launched 112 drones overnight, including 40 jet-powered Shaheds, with strikes recorded at seven locations and debris falling at five others.

vyrez.text:
Ukraine destroys or jams 97 Russian drones during overnight attack | Ukrainska Pravda
A total of 97 drones were downed. Infographic: Ukraine's Air Force
Russia attacked Ukraine with 112 drones on the night of 28-29 October, with strikes recorded at seven locations. Air defence forces have downed 97 UAVs.
Source: Ukraine's Air Force
Details: From 18:00 on 28 October, the Russians launched Shahed and Gerbera attack drones and Parodiya decoy UAVs from the Russian cities of Oryol and Millerovo as well as from temporarily occupied Donetsk. The drones launched included 40 jet-powered Shaheds.
Advertisement:





Aircraft, anti-aircraft missile units, electronic warfare assets, unmanned systems units and mobile fire groups from Ukraine's defence forces have been involved in repelling the attack.
Quote: "As of 08:00, [Ukrainian] air defence forces had destroyed or jammed 97 Shahed (30 jet-powered), Gerbera and other types of drones. Around seven attack drones are still in the air, and combat operations are ongoing.
Hits by drones have been recorded at seven locations and the fall of downed UAVs (debris) at five locations."

titulekPuvodni: Over 600 drones targeted Moscow and surrounding area
shrnuti: Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin claims that 613 drones flew towards Moscow Oblast overnight, while restrictions were imposed at three airports and flights were diverted.

vyrez.text:
Moscow reports more than 600 drones heading towards the Russian capital and surrounding area | Ukrainska Pravda
Column of smoke. Stock photo: Suspilne
Russian authorities have reported an attack involving more than 600 drones targeting the city of Moscow and Moscow Oblast.
Source: Kremlin-aligned Russian news agency TASS ; Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin ; Russian media outlet Astra
Details: Two aircraft flying from Türkiye to Moscow were diverted due to restrictions at Vnukovo Airport amid the drone attack.
Advertisement:





Meanwhile, Russia's Federal Air Transport Agency (Rosaviatsia) imposed restrictions on aircraft arrivals and departures at Vnukovo, Domodedovo and Zhukovsky (Ramenskoye) airports. The restrictions at Zhukovsky were lifted an hour later, but the other two airports were still accepting aircraft subject to approval.
Against this backdrop, Sobyanin claimed that 57 drones heading towards Moscow had been shot down. An air-raid warning was issued in Moscow Oblast at around 22:00 local time.
According to Astra, three explosions were heard at that time near the town of Naro-Fominsk, 56 kilometres from Moscow's main ring road, despite no drone noise being heard.…

Schutz von Kritischer Infrastruktur
Bund beschließt mehr Prüfungen auf Sabotagerisiko
Stand: 28.10.2026 • 15:48 Uhr
Die Bedrohung für die Kritische Infrastruktur in Deutschland - etwa durch Sabotage oder Spionage - ist gestiegen. Daher will der Bund künftig Beschäftigte in noch mehr Betrieben auf mögliche Sicherheitsrisiken überprüfen.
Das Bundeskabinett hat eine Ausweitung der Sicherheitsüberprüfung von Beschäftigten in wichtigen Betrieben der Kritischen Infrastruktur beschlossen. Das soll das Risiko von Sabotageaktionen mit extremistischem Hintergrund oder im Auftrag eines ausländischen Geheimdienstes reduzieren.
Die Verordnung soll Einrichtungen wie etwa die Bahn oder Wasserwerke vor gefährlichen Eingriffen sogenannter Innentäter, also Menschen mit Zugang zu wichtigen Anlagen, schützen. Dafür wird neu bestimmt, welche Behörden und Unternehmensteile sicherheitsempfindlich sind.

Norway and Finland hold rare call with Putin to discuss ending war - BBC News
Image source, AFP via Getty Images
Image caption, Norway and Finland say they are not acting on behalf of other European leaders
By Laura Gozzi   and   Hafsa Khalil
Published
27 October 2026, 13:12 GMT
Updated 1 hour ago
The leaders of Finland and Norway have held a joint call with Vladimir Putin - rare contact between the Russian president and European leaders.
Finland's President Alexander Stubb and Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre said the aim of the call had been to "convey messages directly regarding future negotiations" towards peace. An end to the conflict in Ukraine "will not be achieved through silence," Stubb said.
Neither side suggested the needle had been moved on ending the war, which began when Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022.

titulek: Leaders of Finland and Norway talk to Putin
titulekPuvodni: Leaders of Finland and Norway talk to Putin
shrnuti: Finnish President Alexander Stubb and Norwegian PM Jonas Gahr Støre initiated the call to discuss efforts to end the Ukraine war.

vyrez.text:
Leaders of Finland and Norway talk to Putin – POLITICO
Skip to main content
Advertisement
Finland’s President Alexander Stubb and Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre held a joint call with Russian leader Vladimir Putin on Tuesday as part of international efforts to secure an end to the war in Ukraine.
“The discussion was frank and substantive,” said Stubb said in a statement after the call. “We are neighboring countries to Russia. The outcome of this war will have a direct impact on our and the broader European security. Ending the war requires direct discussions.”
The two leaders — who are firm allies of Ukraine — were not speaking as official representatives of Europe as a whole. The call was held in consultation with Ukraine.
Støre said the European leaders stressed the importance of de-escalation in the call with Putin. “The war comes with enormous human and material costs. The suffering and destruction will impact generations,” he added.
Their conversation comes at a highly sensitive moment as U.S. President Donald Trump pushes for a peace deal. Talks between the U.S., Russia and Ukraine are planned to take place in Abu Dhabi next month.

A significant cache of unexploded bombs from the first world war emerged this summer from rapidly retreating glaciers in the Dolomites, the Italian army has said.
The devices, which included Italian artillery shells and French mortar bombs, were removed and defused by the army’s Julia Alpine brigade, according to a statement.

Alexander Kondratov, the production designer for the Russian TV series Likvidatsiya (Liquidation”), has died at Botkin Hospital in Moscow after being arrested on treason charges, the Russian human rights group Department One said.

titulekPuvodni: Moscow mother of eight charged with financing terrorism over payment to ISIS
shrnuti: Maria Davydova, a 31-year-old Moscow mother of eight, has been arrested on charges of financing terrorism.

vyrez.text:
Moscow mother of eight charged with financing terrorism over payment to ISIS — Meduza
Skip to main content
Moscow mother of eight charged with financing terrorism over payment to ISIS
October 26, 2026, 8:33 am
Source: Meduza
Maria Davydova, a 31-year-old Moscow mother of eight, has been arrested on charges of financing terrorism.
The case was opened in July under Russia’s criminal statute against financing terrorism, and a court authorized her arrest. Davydova was added to Russia’s list of terrorists and extremists.
Citing a source in law enforcement, the Russian state news agency RIA Novosti reported in July that investigators believe Davydova transferred about 15,000 rubles to the Islamic State.
Case materials cited by the Russian state news agency TASS on October 26 state that Davydova “is self-employed, has eight dependent children, including young children and minors, is not married, and has a specialized secondary education.”
Russia’s criminal statute under which Davydova is charged allows for a sentence of up to life in prison.
A military court will hear Davydova’s case. The trial’s start date has not been announced.

titulek: Vrtěti psem: Proč Babiš spustil útok na Českou televizi
titulekPuvodni: Vrtěti psem: Proč Babiš spustil útok na Českou televizi
shrnuti: Vláda krátce po porážce v podzimních volbách rozjela své tažení za změnu financování České televize a Českého rozhlasu. Vezmeme vás na noční sněmovní jednání i na demonstrace do přilehlých ulic.

vyrez.text:
Vrtěti psem: Proč Babiš spustil útok na Českou televizi — Deník N
Premiér Andrej Babiš ve Sněmovně. Foto: Jakub Plíhal, Deník N
Vláda krátce po porážce v podzimních volbách rozjela své tažení za změnu financování České televize a Českého rozhlasu. Vezmeme vás na noční sněmovní jednání i na demonstrace do přilehlých ulic.
Více o poslechu Deníku N
Přidat Deník N mezi oblíbené zdroje
Čas 4.36 v sobotu ráno rozhodně není momentem, kdy by poslanci řešili zákony. Vládní koalice si pro svůj výpad proti veřejnoprávním médiím ale vybrala právě tento okamžik.
Změnu financování ČT a rozhlasu začaly špičky Babišovy koalice řešit silově a také překvapivě – a to až tak, že o tom předem neřekly ani vlastním poslancům.
Noční jednání tak provázely hádky, porušování zvyklostí i ohýbání jednacího řádu. A také protesty veřejnosti. Během celého jednání probíhala demonstrace v okolí Sněmovny, protesty pokračují také během víkendu.
V nové epizodě podcastu Vrtěti psem situaci probíráme s reportérkami Zdislavou Pokornou a Karolínou Blažkovou, které sledovaly jednání přímo na místě – v budově Sněmovny i v místě protestů.
Rozebíráme také, proč Babiš vůbec celou akci spustil.
Všechny díly podcastu…

LÆS OP
ORDBOG TEKST
Af
Jonas Foldager
Aleksander Boelt Bruun
I dag kl. 07:00
Over 40.000 mennesker søgte ned i Kyivs metro under Ruslands massive angreb i sommer. 
For over et år siden begyndte Metroselskabet at undersøge, om Københavns metro også kunne bruges som beskyttelsesrum, sådan som det sker i Kyiv.
Dengang lød det, at undersøgelsen ville være færdig inden for få måneder, men resultaterne fra arbejdet har endnu ikke set dagens lys.
Nu afslører hidtil fortrolige mails mellem Københavns Kommune og Metroselskabet, som DR har fået aktindsigt i, at metroen i dag ikke kan bruges som beskyttelsesrum.
I hvert fald ikke uden omfattende ændringer.
Det bekræfter Lene Sandberg, lektor ved Københavns Professionshøjskole. Hun forsker i samfundssikkerhed,…

Kyiv's power ring under attack: why the capital faces a winter of blackouts | Ukrainska Pravda
Hopes for a mild winter or inaccuracies in Russian strikes will not help Kyiv get through this winter without problems with its electricity supply. The only question is how long the power cuts will last and whether air defence forces and power engineers will manage to prevent the worst-case scenario.
The Russians are continuing their systematic attacks on Kyiv and Kyiv Oblast, seeking to completely destroy the city's combined heat and power plants and break the so-called power ring in order to plunge the capital entirely into darkness and cold.
The city has already lost a significant proportion of its own power generation capacity, while strikes are destroying substations through which electricity is supplied from other regions. In the event of severe frosts and further hits, a scenario involving 20 hours without electricity no longer seems far-fetched.

Romania said Friday that one sailor had died and three were missing after a drone struck and sank a ship in the Black Sea, with the country's president blaming Russia for the attack.
The cargo ship Khoryv, flying the Comoros flag, was "struck by a drone and sank near Romanian territorial waters," President Nicușor Dan wrote in a Facebook post.
Speaking to reporters, Dan said the attack was "clearly part of the escalation that Russia is carrying out in the context of the war in Ukraine."
Romania launched a rescue operation after the Khoryv sent a distress signal around 10:00 am local time, 13 nautical miles from the Romanian port of Constanta.
Romanian authorities said 10 Ukrainian and three Azerbaijani crewmembers were on board.

All four Moscow airports shut down, one declares air raid alert and begins evacuating passengers
October 23, 2026, 12:57 pm
Source: Rosaviatsia
All four of Moscow’s airports — Sheremetyevo, Domodedovo, Vnukovo, and Zhukovsky — closed to arrivals and departures, Rosaviatsia said.
Sheremetyevo declared an air raid alert and told passengers to head to the nearest safe zones and shelters.
Domodedovo announced that, because of temporary restrictions, “flight schedules are being adjusted.”
Vnukovo also reported the closure, explaining that the measures “were due to security considerations.” Passengers were advised to “be prepared for a lengthy wait,” including on board aircraft.
Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said over the past several hours that at least 11 drones had been shot down approaching the capital.
On September 1, Volodymyr Zelensky warned airlines that Russian skies are “becoming unsafe,” saying that “drones will appear in Russian skies in a way that will have to be reckoned with.” He added that Ukraine “doesn’t threaten civil aviation as such,” but…

titulekPuvodni: Pedagogical university and hall of residence damaged in overnight drone attack on Sumy
shrnuti: A Russian drone attack on Sumy damaged Sumy State Pedagogical University and one of its halls of residence. More than 200 windows were blown out. No students or university staff were injured.

A Russian drone attack on Sumy damaged Sumy State Pedagogical University and one of its halls of residence. More than 200 windows were blown out. No students or university staff were injured.
Source: Suspilne Sumy
Details: The UAV strike occurred at around 02:00 on 23 October. Hanna Zaikina, First Vice-Rector of the university, said four buildings had been damaged in the attack, with the main building sustaining the most extensive damage. A university hall of residence was also damaged.

Most of the university's students study remotely, although students on several courses had still been attending some in-person classes on campus.

Romanian President Nicusor Dan has accused Russia of staging a new drone attack on Black Sea shipping
© AFP
Romania said Friday one sailor had died and three were missing after a ship was struck by a drone and sank in the latest attack in the Black Sea that President Nicusor Dan blamed on Russia.
Several ships have been hit by drones off Romania and Bulgaria in recent weeks in what is believed to be spillover from Russia's invasion of Ukraine.
The Khoryv cargo ship, flying the Comoros flag, was "struck by a drone and sank near Romanian territorial waters", Dan said in a Facebook post.
Speaking to reporters, Dan said the attack was "clearly part of the escalation that Russia is carrying out in the context of the war in Ukraine".
Romania launched a rescue operation after the Khoryv sent a distress signal around 10:00 am (0700 GMT) 13 nautical miles from the Romanian port of Constanta.

Organizátoři kontaktovali vojáky prostřednictvím telegramu a nabízeli jim drogy zdarma. Dívka na balíčcích uváděla fiktivní údaje o odesílateli. shrnuti: The president said that Russia remains intent on resolving the conflict once and for all rather than agreeing to a short-lived ceasefire with Kyiv.

By Reuters
Oct. 23, 2026
Vladimir Putin.

Russia n President Vladimir Putin said Thursday that future talks on ending the war against Ukraine should focus on security guarantees for both countries and an overall framework for security throughout Europe.
Putin, interviewed on Russia n state television a day after meeting U.S. special envoy Steve Witkoff, confirmed that Russia was ready to resume U.S.-mediated talks with Ukraine next month.
He restated longstanding Kremlin policy that Russia never wanted to launch its full-scale invasion, but had run into hostile reactions from Ukraine on key issues of concern to Moscow.
Talks on a variety of matters could lead to a positive outcome, Putin said, but Russia remained intent on resolving the conflict once and for all rather than agreeing to a short-lived ceasefire.

shrnuti: A DTEK thermal power plant has stopped generating electricity after Russian forces heavily damaged its equipment. The company has not disclosed which station was hit.

Russian attack forces DTEK thermal power plant to halt electricity generation | Ukrainska Pravda
Stock photo: DTEK
Russian forces have launched a large-scale attack on a thermal power plant belonging to Ukraine's largest private energy company DTEK, causing significant damage to its equipment.
Source: DTEK
Quote: "The power plant has stopped generating electricity."
Advertisement:





Details: DTEK did not specify which thermal power plant had been hit.
The company also noted that Russian forces had attacked DTEK's thermal power plants more than 230 times since the beginning of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine.
Background: Russian forces attacked the Trypillia Thermal Power Plant in Kyiv Oblast on 30 September, damaging its power generation equipment.

Zunehmend Vorfälle in Europa
Karte zeigt hybride Angriffe durch Russland
Mit dem anhaltenden Angriffskrieg Russlands auf die Ukraine häufen sich auch die Vorfälle hybrider Kriegsführung in Europa. Immer wieder melden nicht nur Russlands Nachbarstaaten etwa Sabotageakte, Drohnenangriffe und GPS-Störungen. Ein Recherchenetzwerk der European Broadcasting Union (EBU), dem auch der ORF angehört, hat nun die Vorfälle gesammelt. Fachleute sehen die Grenze zwischen Krieg und Frieden zunehmend verschwimmen.
23.10.2026 06.07
Online seit heute, 6.07 Uhr
Erst Ende vergangener Woche haben litauische Behörden einen versuchten Brandanschlag auf ein Unternehmen registriert, das Aufrüstung für das US-Kommunikationssystem Starlink beherbergt. Die Ukraine nutzt das Satellitennetzwerk für ihre Abwehr Russlands. Der „versuchte Sabotageakt“ sei „offensichtlich Teil der hybriden Kriegsführung Russlands“, sagte der litauische Ministerpräsident Mindaugas Sinkevicius. „Ähnliche Aktionen“ habe es zuletzt überall in Europa gegeben, so der Regierungschef weiter.
Der Vorfall reiht sich in eine ganze Serie aus Angriffen…

Russian drone attack on Sumy injures at least two people and damages civilian infrastructure facilities | Ukrainska Pravda
A drone. Stock photo: Getty Images
Russian forces launched a large-scale drone attack on the city of Sumy on the night of 22-23 October, injuring at least two people and damaging civilian infrastructure facilities.
Source: Oleh Hryhorov, Head of Sumy Oblast Military Administration, on Telegram
Quote: "Unfortunately, some of the enemy's drones reached their targets."

On October 21, the team behind the PHP programming language said it had discovered two vulnerabilities . Both scored 9.2 out of 10 on the CVSS scale, a critical severity rating. The vulnerabilities allow attackers to run code remotely on a server without authentication. This could let them gain unauthorized access to files and databases, insert malicious code or alter a website’s content, redirect traffic to other sites, or use the server for DDoS attacks or spam campaigns.

Weltweit hat es Millionen Versuche von Cyberangriffen auf Websites gegeben, nachdem am Mittwoch gravierende Sicherheitslücken in der Programmiersprache PHP bekanntgeworden waren. Angriffe mit Schäden wurden bisher nicht bekannt. Auch in Österreich wurden bisher keine Cyberattacken auf Websites gemeldet, hieß es am Donnerstag vom Innenministerium. Dennoch waren vorsorglich zahlreiche Seiten vom Netz genommen worden. „Diese Nervosität ist Teil des Plans gewesen“, meint Harald Kapper, Präsident der Dachorganisation der Internetwirtschaft (ISPA, Internet Service Providers Austria).

Source: RMF24
Officers from Poland’s Internal Security Agency have detained a 22-year-old Georgian citizen in connection with the murder of Russian performance artist Semyon Skrepetsky, said Tomasz Siemoniak, the coordinator of Poland’s intelligence services.
RMF24 identified the man as Makhmud A. The outlet reported that he helped the suspected killer, who had been detained earlier, by keeping Skrepetsky’s home under surveillance and gathering information about his habits.
Makhmud A. arrived in Poland the day before he was detained and was traveling with two other Georgian citizens. The other two were expelled from the country, RMF24 reported.
Makhmud A. was charged with aiding and abetting murder and illegally possessing weapons and ammunition. He denied the charges.
Russian performance artist Semyon Skrepetsky was killed on June 15 in the Polish city of Biała Podlaska. The first suspect in his murder was detained near Warsaw on June 18.…

Ukrajinské úřady dnes nařídily povinnou evakuaci rodin s dětmi z Kramatorska a Slovjanska, dvou měst, která Ukrajinci stále ovládají v průmyslovém regionu Donbas na východě země. Tato města představují poslední bašty ukrajinské armády v regionu, který se Kreml snaží celý dobýt, píše agentura AFP.
